meta.titre: Duquette Automation — Custom automation for small businesses
meta.description: Custom automation for small and medium businesses: the repetitive tasks your team does by hand become one button in a Windows app with your name on it. Northern New Brunswick and Quebec.

hero.texte: Duquette Automation builds custom automation for small and medium businesses. The repetitive tasks your team does by hand become one button in a Windows app with your name on it.
hero.region: Based in northern New Brunswick. Clients in New Brunswick, Quebec and further afield, remotely.

apercu.legende: The app delivered to Librairie Matulu, in French. Sample data.
apercu.slogan_client: Vous êtes libraire par passion. On s’occupe du reste.

services.titre: Tools built around the way you work

items.texte: Orders, reports, file sorting: custom-built scripts read and process your data to produce a clear, usable result.
Automations build on the tools you already use. When nothing exists for your need, the tool is built from scratch.

items.titre: An app with your brand on it
items.texte: Your team installs nothing technical. A Windows app with your logo and colours finds the right files, runs the automation and opens the result. When something goes wrong, the message says what to do, in plain words, and our team can step in if needed.

prix.texte: for a simple script. The price is agreed with you before work begins, based on how many tasks and programs are involved.

realisations.intro: Two business owners, two trades. They do what they love; their app handles the rest.

slogan: You run a bookshop because you love books.
cas.besoin: Every day, staff reviewed customer orders, book deliveries and inventory by hand. Distributor promotions arrived by email, PDF and Word, each in its own format.

outils.texte: finds the books a customer is waiting for, and shows which order each book belongs to.
every morning, generates the list of books to pull from the shelves, missing copies and orders ready to go.
reads offers from four distributors, compares them with inventory and suggests what to order, by priority.

cas.resultat: Reports become Excel files that open with the actions to take. Besides saving time, the app reduces errors. The bookseller can take the time to share a love of books with the community.

cas.besoin: Every batch of footage from an agency, several dozen clips, took hours of preparation before editing could even start: unzipping, filing, separating shots, building timelines, then fixing subtitles and exporting each video.

outils.texte: from the received zip file to a project ready to edit, with folders created, A and B shots separated by speech detection and silences trimmed.
compares the subtitles the app generates automatically with subtitles produced by a local AI on the editor’s computer, for greater reliability.
finds each video on the edited timeline and exports it under the client’s naming convention.

cas.resultat: The editor opens a timeline that is already prepared and can let their creativity run free to offer clients more.

etapes.texte: You describe the task that eats your time: what you do, how often, and what happens when a mistake slips in. A visit can be arranged for an outside perspective.

etapes.titre: A look at your real files
etapes.texte: The work starts from your needs. Your workflows are documented and our approach is confirmed with you before any code is written.
Results are cross-checked by hand against your files. Every rule applied is visible in the output, so you can trust it or challenge it.
You receive the app under your name, ready to install on your computers, with support contact details shown inside.

paragraphes: I’m Thomas Duquette, a PhD candidate in engineering specializing in robotics. My research is on planning robot motion and verifying its safety. I’ve built many tools for myself and my colleagues, and I now put that experience to work for you.

contact.texte: Describe in a few lines the task you’d like to stop doing by hand. I’ll reply personally.
